info.title: Aestara API
info.description: Staff/admin API (/api/v1) and patient portal API (/api/v1/portal). Conventions: docs/API_CONTRACTS.md and docs/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md §6. Within v1 only additive changes are allowed.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from /auth. Tenant context comes from the token only (spec §6.1.3).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque, signed, expiring cursor from page.nextCursor.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID. Retained per actor for 7 days (spec §6.1.8).

IfMatchWhenExists.name: If-Match
IfMatchWhenExists.description: Required once the resource exists; omit it to create (spec §6.1.7).

ClientRequestId.name: X-Client-Request-Id
ClientRequestId.description: Optional client correlation ID. Logged, never trusted.

Error401.description: Error envelope. Codes: UNAUTHENTICATED, SESSION_INVALID, MFA_REQUIRED.

Error403.description: Error envelope. Codes: PERMISSION_DENIED, REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES, MEDIA_PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED.

Error409.description: Error envelope. Codes: INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, IMMUTABLE_RECORD, DUPLICATE_PATIENT_SUSPECTED, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, CONFLICT, SYNC_CONFLICT.

Error422.description: Error envelope. Codes: UPLOAD_VERIFICATION_FAILED, COMPLETION_PRECONDITIONS_NOT_MET, INCOMPATIBLE_VIEWS, BEFORE_AFTER_ORDER, REQUIRED_VIEWS_MISSING, INPUT_QUALITY_INSUFFICIENT, UNSUPPORTED_SIMULATION_INPUT.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request identifier (UUIDv7). Quote it when reporting a problem.

Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. USD only (ADR-0006); new codes are additive.

Money.description: Monetary amount as a decimal string with two fraction digits, plus its currency.

ErrorCode.description: UPPER_SNAKE error code from the catalog (spec §6.2), or <RESOURCE>_NOT_FOUND. Clients must handle codes they do not recognise by falling back to the HTTP status.

path.description: Dotted path of the invalid field.

FieldError.description: One invalid field in a VALIDATION_FAILED error.

ErrorDetails.description: Optional, code-specific details. Never contains PHI.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to show. No stack traces, SQL or storage keys.
message.example: The requested patient could not be accessed.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every error response has this shape (Bible §20.4).

PageInfo.description: Cursor pagination state. nextCursor is present when hasMore is true.

challengeToken.description: Send back in the body of /auth/mfa/verify. Valid 5 minutes.

factors.description: Confirmed factors the user can answer with.

enrollmentRequired.description: True when MFA is required but no factor is confirmed: enroll TOTP with the challenge first.

accessToken.description: ES256 JWT, 10 minutes. Keep in memory only.

refreshToken.description: iOS apps only: store in the Keychain. The admin web receives it as an HttpOnly cookie.

permissions.description: Effective permissions in the active organization. UI hints only; the server enforces.

ClientApp.description: The client signing in. It decides session lifetimes and the MFA rule (ADMIN_WEB always needs MFA).

Factor.description: A second factor of the signed-in user. Secrets are never returned.

organizationId.description: Optional choice among the caller's active memberships; verified, never trusted.

installationId.description: Per-install identifier kept in the Keychain; only its hash is stored.

DeviceInfo.description: The app install signing in. Required for the iOS apps.

organizationId.description: As in the login request; verified again.

WebAuthnJson.description: A WebAuthn registration or authentication response, as JSON.

refreshToken.description: iOS apps. The admin web sends no body; its refresh token comes from the cookie.

newPassword.description: At least 12 characters. Common and breached passwords are rejected.
At least 12 characters. Common and breached passwords are rejected.

password.description: The new password; or, for a user who already has one, the current password.

otpauthUri.description: otpauth:// URI for a QR code.

challengeToken.description: During sign-in only, when MFA_REQUIRED said enrollmentRequired (TOTP only).
During sign-in only, with the challenge used to start the enrollment.

Jwks.description: JSON Web Key Set of the access-token signing keys.

slug.description: URL-safe, unique organization handle. It never carries PHI.

invitationExpiresAt.description: The invitation is sent by email, never returned.

slug.description: URL-safe, unique organization handle. It never carries PHI.

FirstAdmin.description: Invited as the organization's first ORGANIZATION_ADMIN.

status.description: Platform scope only. An organization cannot change its own status.
Membership status in the caller's organization.

mfaEnrolled.description: At least one confirmed second factor.

UserCreate.description: Invites a person to the organization. An existing account is reused; the invitation goes by email.

OrganizationScope.description: Where a role assignment applies inside the organization.

UserUpdate.description: Changes the person's account, so it is allowed only when the person belongs to no other organization.

IdentityVerificationMethod.description: How the admin confirmed who asked for the reset.

name.description: Start of the last, first or preferred name. Case, accents and punctuation are ignored. Two words match a first-name prefix and a last-name prefix, in either order.

PatientSearchRequest.description: Terms are combined with AND. The body is never logged.

mrn.description: Medical record number, unique in the organization. Optional and entered by staff.
Medical record number, unique in the organization. Optional and entered by staff.

confirmNoDuplicate.description: Set after reviewing probable duplicates. Without it, a probable duplicate returns 409.

PatientCreate.description: null and an absent field mean the same: not recorded.

readable.description: The caller holds the tab's read permission (spec §6.3).

count.description: Items in the tab, only when readable and once the tab's domain layer is built.

mrn.description: Medical record number, unique in the organization. Optional and entered by staff.

PatientUpdate.description: null clears an optional field. ARCHIVED is set only by /archive.

standard.description: One of the Bible §6.2 standard protocols seeded for every organization.

yawDeg.description: The subject's turn from facing the camera; positive shows the left side.

frameFill.description: Subject height as a fraction of the frame.

PoseTarget.description: Target pose and framing tolerances used by live guidance.

supersedesId.description: The protocol this draft replaces; activating the draft retires it.

ProtocolViewInput.description: Views are captured in the order given.

PhotographyProtocolUpdate.description: DRAFT protocols only; views are replaced as a set.

captured.description: A verified photo of this view exists (accepted or being checked).

consultationId.description: Capture for an open consultation of the patient (ADR-0026 K3-06, K3-20): the session takes its practice, and the caller's grant must cover it.

startedAt.description: When capture began on the device (offline sessions); defaults to now. Never in the future.

acknowledgeMissingRequiredViews.description: Complete although required views are missing (422 REQUIRED_VIEWS_MISSING otherwise).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes uploaded.

positionMatchScore.description: Photographic position match, not a medical measurement.
Photographic position match, not a medical measurement. Present when a ghost overlay was used.

referencePhotoId.description: The earlier photo used as the ghost overlay.

CaptureMetadata.description: Device and pose estimates only; never free text.

value.description: The measured value behind the check, when it has one.

GuidanceCode.description: Live capture guidance [B §6.4]. Clients turn each code into one plain instruction.

headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT.

upload.description: Present while the photo waits for its bytes.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes uploaded.

AccessUrl.description: A signed GET, valid 120 seconds; private, no-store.

PhotoVariant.description: ORIGINAL needs photo.export and is always audited.

reason.description: NOT_FOUND covers absent and not visible alike; NOT_READY means no such derivative yet.

patientWideState.description: The current patient-wide state; NOT_REQUESTED when nothing is recorded; expiry applied.

exceptions.description: Current photo- and session-scoped rows; the most specific row wins (ADR-0023 K2-15).

PhotoPermission.description: One version of a media permission (append-only, Bible §7.2).

state.description: The new state; EXPIRED is set only by the system at expiresAt.

evidence.description: Required for GRANTED. STAFF_ATTESTATION until signed consents arrive (Layer 4).

MediaReleaseCreate.description: PATIENT_APP needs consultation.complete; other purposes need photo.export.

id.description: Generated on the device; replays are recognised by it.

AnnotationLayer.description: Version 1: shapes in coordinates normalized to the upright photo. No measurements.

id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 for a layer drawn offline.

PhotoAnnotationUpdate.description: Only the author changes a layer.

failure.description: Why automatic registration found nothing; the set is unchanged.

registrationJob.description: The latest automatic registration requested for this set.

RegistrationMode.description: NONE: no transform. AUTOMATIC: estimated by the registration job. MANUAL: set by a user.

consultationId.description: A consultation of the same patient.

BeforeAfterSetCreate.description: Exactly two accepted, unarchived photos of this patient with the same view, the before one captured earlier.

registration.description: Align by hand, or reset to no transform.

photoIds.description: The photo, or the set's before and after photos.

ExportPurpose.description: Each purpose needs the patient's current grant of the same media-permission category.

ExportKind.description: What the image is: a before/after composite, a photo with one annotation layer drawn in, or a plain photo (MARKETING_DERIVATIVE for website, social media and paid advertising).

ExportStatus.description: REVOKED once the release is revoked, whatever the render did.

ExportFailure.description: SOURCE_CHANGED: the annotation layer changed or was deleted before the render; export again. RENDER_FAILED: the image could not be rendered; no file was produced.

annotationId.description: One of the photo's annotation layers, drawn in.

ExportAccessUrl.description: A signed GET, valid 10 minutes; private, no-store.

concernIds.description: The patient concerns this consultation addresses.

readyForReviewAt.description: When the consultation last went to review.

unmetCompletionPreconditions.description: What /complete would still refuse; empty once the consultation is final.

ConsultationReleaseDecision.description: What the consultation released to the patient before completion (ADR-0026 K3-04). Layer 3 records only NOTHING_TO_RELEASE.

CompletionPrecondition.description: REASON_OR_CONCERN: record a reason or at least one concern. NO_DRAFT_NOTES: finalize or discard every draft note. CURRENT_SUMMARY: generate the summary after the consultation last went to review.

ConsultationUpdate.description: The practice never changes; null clears a field.

reason.description: Why the consultation is cancelled. Stored, never logged.

releaseDecision.description: The provider confirms nothing is released to the patient: nothing reaches a patient before Layer 5 (ADR-0026 K3-04).

concernIds.description: The patient's concerns this consultation addresses; replaces the set.

correctsNoteId.description: The FINAL note this addendum corrects.

id.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 for a note drafted offline.

correctsNoteId.description: Write an addendum to this FINAL note of the consultation (UD-15).

ConsultationNoteUpdate.description: Only the author changes a DRAFT note.

DocumentType.description: Layer 3 creates CONSULTATION_SUMMARY (generated) and UPLOADED_CLINICAL (uploaded by staff).

DocumentVersionStatus.description: From the file: being scanned, available, or rejected by the malware scan and never served.

ConcernArea.description: Anatomical or aesthetic area of a concern (ADR-0026 K3-08).

resolved.description: Mark the concern resolved, or open again.

MedicalHistoryEntry.description: Clinical history: readable with consultation.create, never with patient.read alone.

MedicalHistoryCreate.description: Recorded by staff (source STAFF) in Layer 3.

TimelineItem.description: Metadata only: never text from the record.

TimelineDomain.description: Each domain needs its read permission: patient.read, consultation.create, photo.view, document.read and photo.permission.read.

uploadId.description: Send it to complete-upload once the PUT succeeded.

headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT.

upload.description: Present while the file is awaited.

documentId.description: Add a version to this uploaded document.

title.description: A new document's title. Never audited or logged.

consultationId.description: Link a new document to a consultation of the patient.

DocumentAccessUrl.description: A signed GET, valid 10 minutes, served as an attachment.

metadata.description: Identifiers, codes and counts only; never PHI.

value.description: Shape depends on the key; see the setting schemas.

source.description: Where the value comes from: a practice row wins over an organization row over the default.

practiceId.description: Set the practice's value; absent sets the organization's.

maxAgeDays.description: At most 7: offline use ends with the session's absolute lifetime (ADR-0023 K2-17).

practiceIds.description: The practices whose policies were combined.

EffectiveOfflineCachePolicy.description: The strictest cache policy among the practices the caller's grants cover.

value.description: Shape depends on the key; see the setting schemas.

RetentionPolicy.description: Recorded only: no retention job runs before production readiness (ADR-0023 K2-19).

action.description: DELETE is refused until legal hold is modelled (UD-24).

basis.description: The customer's policy or legal basis, e.g. a records schedule reference.
